features.name: Diamond scatters
features.description: Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger the bonus.

features.name: Progressive multiplier
features.description: Starts with 12 free spins and the multiplier increases by 1x every spin.

features.name: Retriggers
features.description: Up to four retriggers push the multiplier as high as 60x.

review:
A 10-line fruit game with one simple, great idea. Diamond scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger 12 free spins – and the multiplier goes up by 1x on every single spin, win or not.

Three more scatters retrigger, up to four times, which can push the multiplier as high as 60x. Because it grows every spin, the end of a long bonus is where it gets exciting. 96.52% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
